corporate_actions_data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(corporate_actions_data['date'])

    elif kind == 'dividend':

    portfolio_std_dev = np.sqrt(np.dot(weights.T, np.dot(cov_matrix, weights))) * np.sqrt(252)
